name: 120. Bedrock Converse cachePoint after document block (#7613)
description: Regression for #7613. On /v1/chat/completions routed to Bedrock Converse, a type:"file" content block carrying cache_control produced a document block with no trailing cachePoint: core/providers/bedrock/utils.go convertContentBlock's file branch returned only {document} and never read block.CacheControl, while the text and image branches already appended the standalone {cachePoint} block Converse requires. The document was therefore billed as fresh input on every request. Both cases send x-bf-send-back-raw-request and assert on extra_fields.raw_request, because the defect is in request construction and a cache-hit assertion would depend on the model's 4096-token (Haiku 4.5) minimum. Case 1 pins the default breakpoint on Haiku 4.5; case 2 pins that ttl "1h" is forwarded onto the cachePoint on Sonnet 4.6. Red before the fix (content ends at the document), green after.

item.name: Bedrock via /v1: cache_control on a file block emits cachePoint after document (Haiku 4.5) - #7613

exec: var txt = pm.response.text() || '';
var body = {};
try { body = pm.response.json() || {}; } catch (e) { body = {}; }
var rr = (body.extra_fields || {}).raw_request;
if (typeof rr === 'string') { try { rr = JSON.parse(rr); } catch (e) { rr = null; } }
var wire = JSON.stringify(rr || null);
// #7613: convertContentBlock's file branch returned only the document block and never
// read block.CacheControl, so the client's breakpoint vanished on the wire and the
// document was billed as fresh input on every request. Text and image blocks already
// emitted the standalone cachePoint; this pins the document branch doing the same.
pm.test('Bedrock via /v1: cache_control on a file block emits cachePoint after document (Haiku 4.5) - #7613: request succeeds', function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'failed: ' + txt.slice(0, 400)).to.eql(200);
pm.test('Bedrock via /v1: cache_control on a file block emits cachePoint after document (Haiku 4.5) - #7613: document block is followed by a cachePoint block', function () {
pm.expect(rr, 'raw_request missing or unparseable - x-bf-send-back-raw-request not honored: ' + txt.slice(0, 300)).to.be.an('object');
var content = ((rr.messages || [])[0] || {}).content || [];
var docIdx = -1;
for (var i = 0; i < content.length; i++) { if (content[i].document) { docIdx = i; break; } }
pm.expect(docIdx, 'no document block reached Converse: ' + wire.slice(0, 400)).to.be.at.least(0);
var next = content[docIdx + 1] || {};
pm.expect(next.cachePoint, 'cache_control on the file block was dropped - no cachePoint after the document: ' + JSON.stringify(content).slice(0, 600)).to.be.an('object');
pm.expect(next.cachePoint.type, 'cachePoint.type altered: ' + JSON.stringify(next.cachePoint)).to.eql('default');
pm.expect(next.cachePoint.ttl, 'no ttl was sent, none must be emitted: ' + JSON.stringify(next.cachePoint)).to.be.undefined;
